what_is.question: What is Web Memo?
what_is.answer: Web Memo is an intelligent note-taking service that revolutionizes internet browsing. • Instantly memo important parts while reading articles • AI-powered automatic summarization of YouTube videos • Save interesting content to your wishlist Unlike regular bookmarks, it's a completely new approach to knowledge management where you can record your own thoughts and insights systematically.

is_free.question: Is it free?
is_free.answer: Yes! All core features of Web Memo are completely free: • Unlimited memo storage • AI-powered content summarization • Category organization features • Wishlist management • YouTube caption summarization • Mobile app with data synchronization We are committed to providing a great service experience without ads or paid subscriptions.

how_to_use.question: How do I use the service?
how_to_use.answer: You can use Web Memo by installing the Chrome extension. Once installed, you can open the side panel on any website to start taking notes.

where_to_save.question: Where can I save memos?
where_to_save.answer: Web Memo works everywhere on the internet! Install the Chrome extension and you can: • Take notes on blogs and news sites • Organize content from online courses and educational materials • Record insights from YouTube videos • Save information from shopping or product review sites • Summarize key points from research papers Simply press Alt+S (Windows) / Option+S (Mac) to open the side panel and start taking notes immediately.

ai_summary.question: How does the AI summary feature work?
ai_summary.answer: The AI summary feature automatically analyzes the content of the webpage or YouTube video you're viewing and summarizes the key points. For YouTube, it summarizes based on video captions, and for webpages, it analyzes the main text content. When you open the side panel, the summary starts automatically, helping you quickly grasp the essentials of long content.

data_sync.question: Can I sync my memos across multiple devices?
data_sync.answer: Yes! When you log in to Web Memo, all your memos are automatically saved to the cloud. You can access and edit all your memos from any device—PC, laptop, tablet—by logging in with the same account. You can also view your saved memos anytime at {{webDisplayHost}}.

supported_browsers.question: Which browsers are supported?
supported_browsers.answer: Currently, Web Memo is available on Chrome and Chrome-based browsers (Edge, Brave, Arc, etc.). Simply install the extension from the Chrome Web Store to get started. Support for Firefox and Safari is coming soon—stay tuned!

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How Web Memo collects, uses, retains, and shares your data.

summary.title: Summary
items: We store only the notes and highlights you explicitly save, along with the address and title of the page they came from.
The content of a web page is sent to OpenAI only when you actively run an AI feature.
The extension does not collect or store your general browsing history.
We never sell your data and never use it for advertising.

scope.title: Scope
body: This policy applies to the Web Memo Chrome extension, the Web Memo iOS app, and the website at https://{{webDisplayHost}}, referred to together as the "Service".
By using the Service you agree to the data practices described here. If you do not agree, you may stop using the Service and remove the extension at any time.

collect.title: Data we collect
body: Web Memo collects the categories of data listed below. For each category we state exactly when it is collected and what it contains.

account.title: a. Account information
account.description: Collected when you sign in with your Google account, and used for authentication and syncing your data across devices.
items: Email address
Name and profile image
A unique user identifier issued by the Service
Nickname and note-sharing preference, if you set them

content.title: b. Content you save
content.description: Collected only at the moment you press save or create a highlight. We do not collect information about pages you did not save.
items: Note text, impressions, and action items you type
The URL, page title, and favicon address of the page you saved a note or highlight from
The highlighted sentence plus the surrounding text and position values needed to restore the highlight later
Highlight color and any note attached to a highlight
Category names and colors you create, and starred / reading / wishlist flags

page_content.title: c. Web page content (only when you use an AI feature)
page_content.description: Only when you actively run AI summarization, AI question answering, or automatic category suggestion, the text of the page you are viewing is sent through our server to OpenAI. This data is processed solely to generate a response and is not separately stored in our database.
items: The body text and title of the page you are currently viewing
The questions you type and the conversation history in the AI chat feature
Note titles and bodies sent for automatic category classification

usage.title: d. Usage data
usage.description: Collected through Google Analytics to understand how features are used and to improve the Service.
items: Names of feature events and their parameters
Pages visited, page titles, and time spent
Browser type and version, operating system, device type, and approximate region
IP address (processed under Google Analytics policy, and also used to rate-limit API requests)
A unique user identifier used to associate events with your account

diagnostics.title: e. Diagnostic data
diagnostics.description: Collected through Sentry to identify and fix errors. This includes session replay, which records how you interact with the Service screen.
items: Error messages, stack traces, and the screen path where the error occurred
Browser, operating system, device details, and performance measurements
Session replay: a record of clicks, inputs, and navigation within the Service (approximately 10% of all sessions, and 100% of sessions where an error occurs)
A unique user identifier and email address used to associate errors with your account

feedback.title: f. Support and feedback data
feedback.description: Collected only when you submit feedback yourself.
items: The feedback text you write
An email address you optionally provide so we can reply

local.title: g. Data stored only on your device
local.description: The following is kept in your browser storage and is never transmitted to us.
items: Your preferences such as language, theme, and side panel visibility
Authentication tokens that keep you signed in
Login cookies for the Web Memo domain ({{webDisplayHost}}), read solely to carry your website sign-in into the extension. We never access cookies belonging to any other website.

not_collect.title: Data we do not collect
body: Web Memo does not collect any of the following.
items: Your password. Sign-in is handled entirely by Google, and we never store passwords.
Payment information such as credit card numbers. The Service is free and processes no payments.
The content of pages where you neither saved a note or highlight nor ran an AI feature.
Your general browsing history or search history.
Government identification numbers, health information, political opinions, or other sensitive categories of data.

use.title: How we use your data
body: We use collected data only for the purposes below, and delete it once those purposes are fulfilled.
items: Authenticating you and syncing notes and highlights across your devices
Letting you view, search, organize, and restore the notes and highlights you saved
Providing AI summarization, AI question answering, and automatic category suggestion
Diagnosing errors and improving the stability of the Service
Analyzing feature usage in order to improve the Service
Responding to your inquiries and sending service announcements
Preventing abnormal use and API abuse
Sending service guidance emails, such as the sign-up welcome email

permissions.title: Extension permissions and why we need them
body: The Web Memo Chrome extension requests the following permissions for the stated reasons.

share.title: Third parties we share data with
body: We engage the service providers listed below to operate the Service. We do not share user data with any third party outside this list.
Beyond this list, data may be disclosed only in response to a lawful request from authorities under applicable law, or where you have given separate consent.

limited_use.title: Limited use of data
body: Web Memo's use of user data complies with the Limited Use requirements of the Chrome Web Store User Data Policy. Specifically, we affirm the following.
items: We do not sell user data.
We do not use or transfer user data for any advertising purpose, including personalized advertising.
We do not use user data for creditworthiness or lending purposes, and we do not transfer it to data brokers.
We do not use user data for any purpose other than providing the features described in this policy.

No human, including the operator, reads user data. The only exceptions are where you have given explicit consent, where it is necessary for security purposes, where it is required to comply with applicable law, or where the data has been aggregated and anonymized so that no individual can be identified.

retention.title: Retention and deletion
body: Retention periods differ by data category, as follows.
items: Notes, highlights, and categories you saved: retained until you delete them yourself or request account deletion.
Account information: retained while your account exists, and deleted together with related data when you request account deletion.
Page content and conversations sent to AI features: not stored in our database after the response is generated. Retention on OpenAI's side is governed by OpenAI's own policy.
Usage data (Google Analytics): automatically deleted no later than 14 months after collection.
Diagnostic data and session replays (Sentry): automatically deleted no later than 90 days after collection.
Support and feedback data: deleted once the inquiry is resolved and the service improvement purpose is fulfilled.
Where applicable law requires retention, data is stored separately for the required period and then destroyed.

rights.title: Your rights and how to exercise them
body: You have the following rights regarding your data and may exercise them at any time.

For the notes and highlights you saved, you can view, edit, and delete them directly inside the Service. To delete your account and all associated data, contact us using the details below; we will complete the request and reply within 30 days.
items: Request access to, and a copy of, the data we hold about you
Correct inaccurate data
Delete individual notes and highlights (available directly in the Service)
Request deletion of your account and all associated data
Stop all collection by removing the extension
Opt out of Google Analytics by installing the browser opt-out add-on or removing the extension

security.title: Data security
body: We apply the following measures to protect your data.
items: All data in transit is encrypted with HTTPS/TLS.
Row Level Security is enforced in the database so that you can access only your own data.
Authentication is handled exclusively through Google OAuth, and we store no passwords.
API requests are rate-limited to block abnormal access and abuse.

international.title: International transfers
body: Some of the service providers we use operate servers outside the Republic of Korea. As a result, your data may be transferred to, stored in, and processed in the United States and other countries. The destination country, the categories of data transferred, and the purpose for each provider are described in that provider's privacy policy, linked in the third-party table above.

children.title: Children's privacy
body: Web Memo is not directed to children under 14, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 14. If we learn that such data has been collected, we delete it without delay. If you are a parent or guardian and believe this has occurred, please contact us using the details below.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
body: If this policy changes, we will post the revised version on this page and update the last-updated date. For changes that materially affect your rights, such as adding a new category of collected data or changing the purpose of processing, we will provide notice in the Service or by email at least 7 days before the change takes effect.

contact.title: Contact
body: For questions about this policy, or to request access to or deletion of your data, please contact us.
Data protection officer: Kuesung Park
Email: gueit214@naver.com
We respond to requests within 30 days.

storage.name: storage
storage.reason: Saves your sign-in state and preferences such as language and theme in your browser.

tabs.name: tabs
tabs.reason: Reads the address and title of the current tab so they can be attached to the note you are saving.

sidePanel.name: sidePanel
sidePanel.reason: Displays the note-taking interface in the browser's side panel.

contextMenus.name: contextMenus
contextMenus.reason: Adds right-click menu actions for highlighting selected text or saving it as a note.

cookies.name: cookies
cookies.reason: Reads authentication cookies for the Web Memo domain ({{webDisplayHost}}) only, so that your website sign-in carries over to the extension. Cookies belonging to any other website are never accessed.

host_permissions.name: Access to all sites (<all_urls>)
host_permissions.reason: Required so you can save notes and display or restore highlights on any website. Page content is read only at the moment you save it or actively run an AI feature; we never automatically collect or transmit the pages you visit.

supabase.name: Supabase, Inc.
supabase.data: Account information, saved notes, highlights, categories, and feedback content

openai.name: OpenAI, L.L.C.
openai.purpose: AI summarization, AI question answering, and automatic category suggestion
openai.data: Body text and title of the page where you ran an AI feature, AI conversation content, and note content sent for classification

google_auth.name: Google LLC (Google Sign-In)
google_auth.purpose: Authenticating you through your Google account
google_auth.data: Email address, name, and profile image

google_analytics.name: Google LLC (Google Analytics)
google_analytics.purpose: Analyzing how the Service is used
google_analytics.data: Feature events, page paths, browser and device information, IP address, and a unique user identifier

sentry.name: Functional Software, Inc. (Sentry)
sentry.data: Error logs and stack traces, browser and device information, session replay recordings, and a unique user identifier and email address

vercel.name: Vercel Inc.
vercel.data: Request IP address, request headers, and other access logs

upstash.name: Upstash, Inc.
upstash.purpose: Rate limiting and abuse prevention for AI features
upstash.data: Requester IP address and request counts

trash.emptyDescription: Deleted memos gather here. Nothing has been thrown away yet.
trash.restoreFailed: Couldn't restore it. Please try again in a moment.
trash.deleteFailed: Couldn't delete it for good. Please try again in a moment.
